title: Chapter 71 Rebuilding The Deserted City
content:
Chapter 71 Rebuilding The Deserted City

When the old man saw the shit-yellow pill, his eyes suddenly widened.

Seeing the old man's eager eyes, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "Do you want it?"

Hearing this, the old man said directly, "Whatever you want, just tell me. As long as my Shenshan can do it, I will do it at all costs!"

The old man could truly feel that the pill would definitely make him improve his cultivation.

He has been in the God King Realm for tens of millions of years!

For the breakthrough of the realm, he has been eager to the point of being almost obsessed.

It is precisely because of this that his realm has stopped moving forward.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng said, "This thing is for you. After you break through, go and deal with the Jiemeng. I don't ask you to defeat the Jiemeng, as long as you can delay them and cause them some trouble."

"Do you understand?"

Hearing this request, the old man's face was overjoyed.

This is too simple.

Even if Lu Daosheng didn't say it, he would do so after the breakthrough.

"Senior, deal!"

At this moment, the old man's way of addressing Lu Daosheng changed.

After handing the pill to the old man, Lu Daosheng took a last look at the God Mountain and then left.

This God Mountain is indeed powerful, and the entire God Mountain is blessed with a unique luck.

Looking at the pill in his hand, the old man seemed to be dreaming.

Then, crazy laughter continued to sound from this starry sky.

And soon, a powerful God King will appear in the God Mountain again.

On the way back.

Lu Daosheng's pace was not very fast, and he was thinking at this moment.

Although he had a lot of resources, almost unlimited, it would take a long time for the strength of the deserted city to catch up with him.

Even if he could change the speed of time, it would be the same.

Some realms cannot be raised simply by time.

And the enemies of the deserted city will not just wait for his deserted city to develop peacefully.

So he can only rely on himself to delay time and strive for the opportunity for the deserted city to develop.

In this case, it would be better to do it yourself.

Thinking of this, Lu Daosheng stopped and looked back in the direction of the Jiemeng.

Or, should we destroy the Jiemeng now?

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng finally shook his head.

In his eyes, the Jiemeng was just an ant nest. He really had no interest in destroying an ant nest.

Unless the other party really angered him.

Create another force.

This is a method he just thought of.

Create another deserted city outside the Wanling Realm. When the strength of the deserted city in the Wanling Realm is sufficient, you can go to the newly built deserted city.

Suddenly, Lu Daosheng was directly convinced by his own intelligence.

I am really a genius.

Or I know how to play.

Then Lu Daosheng became interested and rushed back to the Wanling Realm without stopping.

At the same time, at the ruins of the Human Emperor Palace in the Wanling Realm.

"Miss, the Human Emperor Palace is ahead."

Looking at the hazy land ahead, you can vaguely see countless building ruins.

A creepy aura is constantly emanating from it, which is enough to imagine how powerful the Human Emperor Palace was back then.

At this time, countless creatures have gathered here, and almost all those with some strength have come here, intending to enter the ruins to try their luck.

Lu Xue looked at the Human Emperor Palace not far in front of her with a calm expression.

At this time, the Xuanyuan Sword in her hand suddenly began to hum.

"Hmm?"

Looking at the Xuanyuan Sword trembling at this moment, Lu Xue frowned.

Aside, An Xing hesitated and said, "Miss, this sword is extraordinary, and it seems to want to go in."

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded.

"Then let's go in."

An Xing and Ouyang Yanqing had no objections, and as for Ao Qing, they ignored him directly.

Then they were about to move forward.

At this time, a strong elf reminded: "Everyone, the ruins have not been officially opened yet. If you enter rashly, you may die."

Seeing that Lu Xue and the others were human, he kindly reminded them.

After all, the human race is strong now, and who doesn't want to curry favor with the human race?

What's more, the Human Emperor Palace in front of them was the power of the human race back then.

Hearing this, Lu Xue smiled and said, "Thank you for your reminder, brother. We will be careful."

Then Lu Xue and the others went directly to the ruins of the Human Emperor Palace.

Seeing this, the strong elf was stunned for a moment, and then shook his head, "This human race is so conceited."

Didn't you see that so many strong people were waiting outside at this moment?

Even the strong people in the heaven realm didn't dare to act rashly.

Lu Xue and the others entered the Human Emperor Palace so swaggeringly. In his eyes, it was like sending themselves to death.

Soon, many creatures noticed Lu Xue and the others.

Because no one dared to enter at this moment, Lu Xue and the others suddenly became particularly eye-catching.

"Fuck, who are those people, so brave!"

"Is that, the human race?"

"No way, could it be that they dare to enter the Human Emperor Palace so recklessly because they rely on their human race status?"

There were also some human race people present, but they were a little few.

There were even people from the Desolate City among them, but in the Desolate City, there were very few people who knew Lu Xue, Ouyang Yanqing and An Xing.

So except for a few strong men from the Phoenix Clan, no one recognized Lu Xue and the others.

Even if the human race is present, no one dares to enter the ruins of the Human Emperor Hall at this time. After all, the restriction outside the Human Emperor Hall has not completely disappeared at this moment.

Even if the Human Emperor Palace is a human force, no one dares to guarantee that the human Emperor Palace's ban will not be activated when the human race enters?

Just when everyone was about to watch Lu Xue and the others make jokes, Lu Xue and the others stopped in front of the Human Emperor Palace ban.

"Huh? Why did you stop? You won't be timid, right?"

Seeing Lu Xue and the others stop, someone immediately asked in confusion.

At this time, before the ban, Lu Xue was turning something inside her ring. She was not stupid, so how could she just swayed in.

Then you will definitely use some special treasures.

And at this moment, the Xuanyuan Sword floated aside and suddenly moved.

I saw that the Xuanyuan Sword swung casually in front of me, and suddenly, the entire restriction outside the Human Emperor Palace was cut out of a gap.

"Yeah? The little sword is amazing."

Then Lu Xue held the Xuanyuan Sword and walked in with An Xing and Ouyang Yanqing.

At this time, everyone was completely confused outside the ruins.

Such a terrifying restriction was cut out so casually.

What kind of sword is that?

You know, even a few powerful people in the field were helpless against the restriction.

Soon, some people reacted and looked at the gap and were ready to move.

Now let’s go into the ruins first, and the competitive pressure will definitely be greatly reduced.

Then several people rushed towards the gap.

However, when they arrived, they were really stunned.

I saw that the gap healed.

It heals!

"Damn, is there any reason for nature?!"

And at this time, it is in the deserted city.

Lu Daosheng has already returned. Seeing that his daughter was still safe and sound at this time, Lu Daosheng nodded and began to prepare for his own affairs.

He wants to build a deserted city again.

Of course, the level is definitely much better than the current wasteland city.

Then Lu Daosheng opened the system store again and began to plunder.
